edges.reason: mint is guarded by onlyMinter which checks hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, _msgSender()), so caller identity controls minting.
canTransfer(_msgSender()) decides whether the caller may move tokens.
transferFrom applies canTransfer(from), but allowance reduction uses _msgSender().
finishMinting relies on the onlyOwner modifier comparing _owner to _msgSender().
enableTransfer is onlyOwner guarded.
disableTransfer is onlyOwner guarded.
recoverERC20 is onlyOwner; caller identity gates arbitrary token extraction.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner guarded.
grantRole checks hasRole(adminRole, _msgSender()) before granting.
Roles constructor grants all roles to _msgSender() at deployment.
OMLira constructor mints the full supply to owner(), derived from _msgSender().
onlyOwner modifier reverts unless _owner equals _msgSender().
onlyOwner gate on enableTransfer.
onlyOwner gate on disableTransfer.
onlyOwner gate on recoverERC20.
onlyOwner gate on transferOwnership.
canMint modifier requires !_mintingFinished before mint executes.
canMint prevents finishMinting from being called twice.
canTransfer requires _transferEnabled or OPERATOR role before transfers proceed.
canTransfer gates transferFrom on the global transfer flag.
finishMinting writes _mintingFinished = true, disabling future minting.
enableTransfer writes _transferEnabled = true.
disableTransfer writes _transferEnabled = false.
Constructor mints to owner(), the Ownable state variable.
Constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
Constructor calls finishMinting immediately after minting.
mint forwards to ERC20._mint.
_mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook implemented by OMLira.
OMLira.transfer delegates to super.transfer (ERC20.transfer).
OMLira.transferFrom delegates to super.transferFrom (ERC20.transferFrom).
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance via _approve.
_transfer mutates sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_mint increases the balance of the recipient.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
ERC20Capped hook compares totalSupply().add(amount) against _cap, so a cap bypass would be arithmetic.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add/sub for balance updates.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance updates.
SafeMath.add computes the checked sum into the local variable c.
transferAndCall first performs a plain transfer.
transferAndCall then runs the external callback helper _checkAndCallTransfer.
transferFromAndCall first performs transferFrom.
transferFromAndCall invokes the callback helper after moving tokens.
approveAndCall performs the allowance update via approve/_approve.
approveAndCall invokes the external spender callback helper.
_checkAndCallTransfer makes an uncontrolled external call to the receiver contract, enabling reentrancy into token state.
_checkAndCallApprove makes an uncontrolled external call to the spender contract.
The callback return value is stored in the retval local.
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas to an arbitrary recipient.
recoverERC20 calls an owner-supplied token contract, an external call that can reenter.
recoverERC20 sends the recovered tokens to owner().
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with the new address.
grantRole mutates the _roles mapping through _grantRole.
Roles constructor seeds _roles with DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER and OPERATOR.
burnFrom computes the reduced allowance into decreasedAllowance.
burnFrom re-approves the reduced allowance.
burnFrom reads allowance(account, _msgSender()), binding the caller into the burn path.
The to parameter flows into the transfer recipient.
The value parameter flows into the transfer amount.
The to parameter flows into the mint recipient.
The value parameter flows into the minted amount.
newOwner becomes the new _owner, affecting all onlyOwner checks.
tokenAddress is the external contract invoked with transfer inside recoverERC20.
tokenAmount is passed as the transfer amount in recoverERC20.
spender is both the approved address and the contract receiving the external callback.
Caller-controlled data is forwarded verbatim to the spender callback.
Caller-controlled data is forwarded verbatim to the receiver callback.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to only feeds OMLira.transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
Parameter value only feeds OMLira.transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
Parameter to only feeds OMLira.mint; fold it into the mint function node.
Parameter value only feeds OMLira.mint; fold it into the mint function node.
newOwner only feeds transferOwnership and its effect on _owner.
tokenAddress only feeds recoverERC20 and the external call it makes.
tokenAmount only feeds recoverERC20's external transfer amount.
decreasedAllowance is a temporary inside burnFrom and has no external visibility.
retval holds the return value of the external callback initiated by _checkAndCallTransfer.
Local c is the intermediate sum of SafeMath.add and carries no independent semantics.
spender only participates in approveAndCall and its callback target.
data only flows from approveAndCall into the external spender callback.
data only flows from transferAndCall into the external receiver callback.
